proposal_title: Event Envelope Standardization with OpenTelemetry Distributed Tracing & Topic Naming
domain_specific_rationale: From a platform engineering and cross-cutting infrastructure perspective, standardized event envelope packaging and native OpenTelemetry distributed tracing context propagation are critical requirements. Prior specification artifacts contained structural contradictions between CONTRACTS_OVERVIEW.md and event-envelope.schema.json, along with inconsistent PascalCase and dotted naming conventions. CP-005 resolves these discrepancies by establishing a unified JSON schema draft-07 contract (event-envelope.schema.json) with strict UUID formats for event_id and correlation_id, formal 16-hex and 32-hex regex patterns for span_id and trace_id, schema_version semantics, and an explicit lowercase dotted regex (^avf\.[a-z0-9_-]+(\.[a-z0-9_-]+)+$) for topic routing. This enables robust asynchronous telemetry correlation across polyrepo microservices, browser automation workers, and workflow orchestrators without custom middleware hacks.

capability_impact: Directly preserves and reinforces CAP-04 (Event-Driven Integration) and CAP-14 (Platform Observability), ensuring end-to-end trace correlation and deterministic topic routing across all 15 repositories.
residual_risk: Producers at peripheral workers might omit optional trace_id/span_id headers under degraded execution contexts. Mitigated by R14 observability client middleware automatically generating or propagating root spans on publish.
